name: jpai-essentials
description: Documentation and diagramming essentials from jpeak.ai: repo documentation organisation (librarian), documentation quality auditing and authoring (gooddocs), Mermaid diagram rendering with WCAG contrast enforcement (mermaidjs-diagrams), rich HTML companions to markdown (richdocs), single-question decision consolidation (concise-decisions), and de-branding of docs to generic placeholders (agnostic). Ships the PreToolUse working-agreements coaching hook. Skills are mirrored from the canonical skills/ tree by scripts/sync_plugins.py, so a pack can never drift from the copy it was built from.

interface.shortDescription: Docs organisation, docs quality, Mermaid QA, rich HTML companions, decision triage
interface.longDescription: The documentation and diagramming half of the jpeak.ai skill set. librarian shelves a repo's documents so the canonical set exists and every doc sits where its content says it belongs. gooddocs keeps docs true (audit against the code), great (write and improve) and navigable (restructure). mermaidjs-diagrams renders and analyses Mermaid diagrams, enforcing visual complexity limits and WCAG colour contrast. richdocs generates interactive HTML companions to markdown with a vendored draw.io stencil library. concise-decisions consolidates accumulated ambiguities into one fully-briefed decision question, self-answering from existing decision records first. agnostic keeps documentation generic by renaming project-specific names to open-source-style placeholders. A PreToolUse hook turns blocked tool calls into coaching redirects. Every skill is mirrored from the canonical skills/ tree by scripts/sync_plugins.py, so a pack can never drift from the copy it was built from.
